newsitem.title: UK: Ford sets British prices for small Ka range.
newsitem.headline: Ford sets British prices for small Ka range.

text.p: Ford Motor Company, the UK arm of the U.S. car giant, on Tuesday announced domestic market prices for its new Ka model range at the British International Motor Show in Birmingham.
The first model in the mini-car range will cost 7,350 stg, with the Ka 2 model priced at 8,195 stg.
Ford said the insurance ratings for the vehicles would help increase their competitiveness in a tough market.
The company added that British prices for its revamped Mondeo range would be held frozen at the same level as the old models.
